A few problems:

  1. Remove the three Element {}s

  2. The background property is invalid. You need to define the gradient separately from the colour, so that it will fall back if the browser doesn't support gradients.

  3. linear-gradient does not have center top as a valid option. See here for detailed syntax.

  4. -moz only applies to Mozilla browsers (Firefox). Until linear-gradient becomes standard across all browsers, you need to add vendor prefixes for each browser (Chrome/Safari, Firefox, Internet Explorer, and Opera).

Here is an example of the first rule. You should be able to figure out the changes for the other 2 :)

.tabmenu li.disabled a.contribute {
 background: transparent;
 background: -webkit-linear-gradient(top, #028f1e, #0C521E);
 background: -moz-linear-gradient(top, #028f1e, #0C521E);
 background: -ms-linear-gradient(top, #028f1e, #0C521E);
 background: -o-linear-gradient(top, #028f1e, #0C521E);
}
